notablePrerequisites: Smoke Shroud attached to Universal Automaton.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Universal Automaton for {1}.
Smoke Shroud triggers, returning from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Universal Automaton.
Repeat.
